1.title: Trouble in the Empire
1.summaryZh: 本集介绍了汉朝后期的动荡。年幼的灵帝无法掌控朝政，官员夺权，饥荒使天下混乱。刘备在村里卖草鞋，生活贫困。与此同时，张角得到一本神秘书，学会了法术，后来背弃同情心，组织黄巾军攻击忠于汉室的人。最后，一对父子逃难到刘备所在的村子，故事即将把他们和刘备联系起来。
1.summaryEn: The Han empire is falling into chaos. Liu Bei is poor but kind, while Zhang Jue gains magical power and turns his followers into the Yellow Turban army.

characters.name: Liu Bei
characters.noteZh: 卖草鞋的年轻人，生活贫困，但故事暗示他将改变中国。
characters.noteEn: A poor young man who sells straw shoes and is about to change China.

characters.name: Zhang Jue
characters.noteZh: 得到神秘书后学会法术，后来追求权力并组织黄巾军。
characters.noteEn: A man who learns magic, gains followers, and forms the Yellow Turban army.

characters.name: Emperor Ling
characters.noteZh: 年幼即位，朝廷官员趁机夺权。
characters.noteEn: The young ruler of the Han empire.

keySentences.sentence: They believed Liu Bei was destined for greatness.
keySentences.translation: 他们相信刘备注定会有伟大成就。

2.title: Frightening Tales
2.summaryZh: 本集承接上一集，刘备看到逃难的父子后非常同情。他低价把鞋卖给他们，表现出善良。随后，越来越多的难民来到村子，讲述黄巾军的可怕故事。刘备看到太守刘焉招募健康男子组建军队，想为皇帝和汉室作战，但因为没有钱而叹气。就在这时，一个洪亮的声音从他身后响起。
2.summaryEn: Liu Bei helps a poor man and his son. Later he hears frightening stories about the Yellow Turbans and wants to fight for the Han, but he has no money to form an army.

characters.name: Liu Bei
characters.noteZh: 善良、同情百姓，想为汉室作战。
characters.noteEn: A kind man who wants to help people and fight for the Han.

characters.name: Liu Yan
characters.noteZh: 当地太守，发布告示招募男子组建军队。
characters.noteEn: The local governor who asks healthy men to form armies.

characters.name: Zhang Jue
characters.noteZh: 黄巾军首领，被人们描述为能控制天气的魔法师。
characters.noteEn: The Yellow Turban leader described as a magician.

keySentences.sentence: I have no reason to pity myself.
I would gladly fight for my emperor.
keySentences.translation: 我很愿意为我的皇帝而战。

3.title: Two Fierce Men
3.summaryZh: 本集刘备遇到了张飞。张飞一开始责备刘备只会叹气，但得知刘备忠于汉室且想组建军队后，愿意出钱支持。两人去酒馆商量计划，张飞在门口教训了一个想加入黄巾军的人。酒馆里，刘备和张飞又遇到了关羽。关羽也想加入军队、消灭黄巾军，但他和张飞都认为自己是天下最强的战士，冲突即将发生。
3.summaryEn: Liu Bei meets Zhang Fei, who offers to support him with money. Then they meet Guan Yu, another fierce fighter who also wants to fight the Yellow Turbans.

characters.name: Liu Bei
characters.noteZh: 忠于灵帝，认为为汉室作战是自己的责任。
characters.noteEn: Loyal to Emperor Ling and willing to fight for the Han.

characters.name: Zhang Fei
characters.noteZh: 勇猛、有钱、性格冲动，愿意帮助刘备组建军队。
characters.noteEn: A fierce and wealthy man who wants to help Liu Bei form an army.

characters.name: Guan Yu
characters.noteZh: 高大勇猛，想加入军队消灭黄巾军。
characters.noteEn: A tall fierce man who wants to join an army and defeat the Yellow Turbans.

keySentences.sentence: It’s my duty to fight for the Han.
keySentences.translation: 为汉室作战是我的责任。

keySentences.sentence: I’m sure I could beat you.
